caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic cup and a matching saucer placed against a plain light-colored background. The cup is positioned above the saucer and is shown with its handle on the right side. The outer surface of the cup features decorative dark brown patterns, including curls and dots, and the word "Mercer" written in a cursive style. The saucer is shown from a top-down perspective and has a similar decorative motif along its rim, with the words "Greensboro Silver Cornet Band" written around the perimeter in a continuous circular arrangement. Both the cup and saucer have a consistent brown color with darker accents for the decorations and text, and their interiors and central areas show shading that suggests a rounded, recessed form. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name "Robert Stewart" appears in small brown letters.
title: Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
